item.title: RUMOR: GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY Star Chris Pratt Will Return As Star-Lord In TWO 2026 MCU Projects
item.description: Marvel Studios first teased plans for The Legendary Star-Lord to return at the end of Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3, and it sounds like 2026 will be a big year for Chris Pratt's Peter Quill.

item.title: MCU Phase 4 Actor Not Seen Since 2021 Confirms They Will Return In AVENGERS: SECRET WARS
item.description: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings star Simu Liu has confirmed that he will return as the Master of the Martial Arts in the upcoming Avengers: Secret Wars.

item.title: BATMAN v SUPERMAN: DAWN OF JUSTICE Unreleased Posters And Banners May Be Even Better Than The Movie Itself
item.description: Newly revealed posters and banners for 2016's Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice showcase previously unseen shots of the title characters, along with the likes of Wonder Woman and Lex Luthor.

item.title: THE RIP: Matt Damon & Ben Affleck Can't Trust Anyone In Action-Packed New Trailer
item.description: It may only be January, but Netflix is getting the year started with a big bang as they gear up to release their highly anticipated crime thriller The Rip, which stars Matt Damon & Ben Affleck!

item.title: 2026's Marvel And DC Movies Ranked From Least To Most Anticipated
item.description: Four major Marvel and DC movies are being released in theaters this year, and we're now ranking Supergirl, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Clayface, and Avengers: Doomsday from least to most anticipated.

item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios Has Big Plans For The Venom Symbiote In The Next SPIDER-MAN Trilogy
item.description: This isn't the first time we've heard about Marvel Studios' plans for the Venom Symbiote in Spider-Man: Brand New Day and beyond, and we have another big update for you today.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's Doctor Doom Teams Up With [SPOILER]; Reason For X-MEN Universe Return Revealed
item.description: A new Avengers: Doomsday rumour reveals that Doctor Doom's plan includes an unexpected team-up. We also have possible news on how the X-Meh Universe comes into play.

item.title: TOMB RAIDER Star Sophie Turner Teases Intense Prep And Promises Fans "Something Special"
item.description: Tomb Raider star Sophie Turner has shared some insights into how she's preparing for the role of Lara Croft, and promises fans that the series is shaping up to be "something special."

item.title: DEADPOOL 2 Star Zazie Beetz Fights For Her Life In Blood-Soaked New Trailer For THEY WILL KILL YOU
item.description: Warner Bros. has debuted the first official trailer for their upcoming action horror comedy They Will Kill You, showcasing some seriously bloody footage as Zazie Beetz fights for her life.
